title: 听力挑战 · 描述新闻事件

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: Did you watch the news about the big earthquake last night?
rounds.lineCn: 你昨晚看大地震的新闻了吗?

grammar.name: 分词作后置定语
grammar.note: 现在分词 arriving 修饰 team,相当于定语从句 who arrived。

options.text: Yes, the team arriving first saved many people.
options.feedback: arriving first 作后置定语修饰 team,结构正确。

options.text: No, the earthquake happened long ago.
options.feedback: 混淆时间,昨晚的新闻与旧闻混淆。

options.text: Yes, I live near the ocean.
options.feedback: 谈居住地点,与新闻内容无关。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: What do you think of the story in the paper?
rounds.lineCn: 你觉得报纸上那篇报道怎么样?

grammar.name: 过去分词作后置定语
grammar.note: written by... 作定语修饰 story,表示'被……写的'。

options.text: The story written by a young reporter is moving.
options.feedback: written by 过去分词短语作定语,表达准确。

options.text: The paper was sold out yesterday.
options.feedback: 谈报纸售罄,没有评价报道内容。
陈述纸张原料,答非所问。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: Have you seen the photos taken by the young journalist this week?
rounds.lineCn: 你看了这周那位年轻记者拍的照片吗?

grammar.name: 分词作定语表被动
grammar.note: taken by 过去分词短语修饰 photos,表示'被拍的'。

options.text: Yes, the photo showing the rescue touched my heart.
options.feedback: showing 现在分词作定语,评价照片内容贴切。
谈拍摄动作,没有回答是否看过照片。

options.text: No, I have never been to a hospital.
options.feedback: 谈医院经历,与照片话题无关。
